integrity: A published structural fact reduces every binary completely reachable automaton to the normalized full-cycle-letter form. All n^n choices of the other letter are then exhausted for n from two through eight. Exact subset-automaton BFS determines complete reachability and every reaching threshold; an independent replay verifies the representative.
scientific_limitations: The exact minimum is for binary completely reachable automata. Counts are given in a normalization that fixes the necessarily present full-cycle letter, so the 544 presentations and 68 rotation orbits are not asserted to be abstract-isomorphism counts. No classification beyond eight states is claimed.
title: Eight states are minimal for a binary Don-counterexample
